ruleGuardProof: FutureRule constructor bounds offsets below one day and rule times below seven days. Events shift by less than eight days from their calendar dates. Months2..11 keep events inside their UTC year; at least one intervening month prevents shifts reversing event order. Stable yearly order determines phase before first event from prior final event. January/December,adjacent/same months,Day/Julian rules retain original three-year search.
